changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Field') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Field]( [AssetID] [bigint] NULL, [ObjectType] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NOT NULL, [FieldTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [Value] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [FormattedValue] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_Field_UpdatedBy] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [ID] [bigint] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_Field_UpdatedOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Field] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ObjectType] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC, [FieldTypeID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Field_FieldType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Field] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_Field_FieldType] FOREIGN KEY([FieldTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[FieldType] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Field] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_Field_FieldType] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_Field') BEGIN CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX [CIX_Field] ON [dbo].[Field] ( [ObjectType] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'UQ_Field_ID') BEGIN CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [UQ_Field_ID] ON [dbo].[Field] ( [ID] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Field_AssetID_Include') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Field_AssetID_Include] ON [dbo].[Field] ( [AssetID] ASC ) INCLUDE([FieldTypeID],[Value],[FormattedValue]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Field_FieldTypeID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Field_FieldTypeID] ON [dbo].[Field] ( [FieldTypeID] ASC ) INCLUDE([ObjectType],[ObjectID]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Field_FieldTypeID_Include') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Field_FieldTypeID_Include] ON [dbo].[Field] ( [FieldTypeID] ASC ) INCLUDE([FormattedValue],[Value]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Field_FieldTypeID_Include_date') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Field_FieldTypeID_Include_date] ON [dbo].[Field] ( [FieldTypeID] ASC ) INCLUDE([UpdatedOn]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Field_ObjectID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Field_ObjectID] ON [dbo].[Field] ( [ObjectID] ASC ) END

changeSet.author: kmcnamee
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.fulltext_indexes f inner join sys.objects t on t.object_id = f.object_id and name = 'Field') BEGIN CREATE FULLTEXT INDEX ON [dbo].[Field] KEY INDEX [UQ_Field_ID] ON [FieldCatalog] END
IF EXISTS (select 1 from sys.columns c inner join sys.fulltext_index_columns f on f.object_id = c.object_id and f.column_id = c.column_id and c.name = 'Value' inner join sys.objects t on t.object_id = f.object_id and t.name = 'Field') BEGIN ALTER FULLTEXT INDEX ON [dbo].[Field] DROP ([Value]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select 1 from sys.columns c inner join sys.fulltext_index_columns f on f.object_id = c.object_id and f.column_id = c.column_id and c.name = 'FormattedValue' inner join sys.objects t on t.object_id = f.object_id and t.name = 'Field') BEGIN ALTER FULLTEXT INDEX ON [dbo].[Field] ADD ([FormattedValue] LANGUAGE 1033) END

changeSet.author: Quinlivan/Pappas/TDuric/PuneetGupta
changeSet.sql:
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Field') BEGIN if exists (select * from sys.indexes where Name = 'PK_Field' and type_desc = 'NONCLUSTERED') begin ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Field] DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS [PK_Field] end
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS [CIX_Field] ON [dbo].[Field] WITH ( ONLINE = OFF ) DROP INDEX IF EXISTS [IX_Field_FieldTypeID] ON [dbo].[Field] DROP INDEX IF EXISTS [IX_Field_ObjectID] ON [dbo].[Field] DROP INDEX IF EXISTS [IX_Field_AssetID_Include] ON [dbo].[Field] DROP INDEX IF EXISTS [IX_Field_AssetIDFieldTypeID_Include] ON [dbo].[Field] DROP INDEX IF EXISTS [IX_Field_IntersectIDFieldTypeId] ON [dbo].[Field] DROP INDEX IF EXISTS [IX_Field_IssueIDFieldTypeId] ON [dbo].[Field]
set nocount on; declare @includes table (name varchar(250)) insert into @includes values ('Value'), ('FormattedValue') declare @count int = 0 select @count = count(1) from sys.indexes ix inner join sys.index_columns ixc on ix.object_id = ixc.object_id and ix.index_id = ixc.index_id inner join sys.tables tab on ix.object_id = tab.object_id inner join @includes I on I.name = COL_NAME(ix.object_id, ixc.column_id) where ix.name = 'IX_Field_FieldTypeIDAssetID_Include' and tab.name = 'Field' and ixc.is_included_column = 1 if (@count <> 1) begin DROP INDEX IF EXISTS [IX_Field_FieldTypeIDAssetID_Include] ON [dbo].[Field] end
delete @includes where name = 'FormattedValue' set @count = 0 select @count = count(1) from sys.indexes ix inner join sys.index_columns ixc on ix.object_id = ixc.object_id and ix.index_id = ixc.index_id inner join sys.tables tab on ix.object_id = tab.object_id inner join @includes I on I.name = COL_NAME(ix.object_id, ixc.column_id) where ix.name = 'IX_Field_FieldTypeIdIntersectID' and tab.name = 'Field' and ixc.is_included_column = 1 if (@count <> 1) begin DROP INDEX IF EXISTS [IX_Field_FieldTypeIdIntersectID] ON [dbo].[Field] end
set @count = 0 select @count = count(1) from sys.indexes ix inner join sys.index_columns ixc on ix.object_id = ixc.object_id and ix.index_id = ixc.index_id inner join sys.tables tab on ix.object_id = tab.object_id inner join @includes I on I.name = COL_NAME(ix.object_id, ixc.column_id) where ix.name = 'IX_Field_FieldTypeIdIssueID' and tab.name = 'Field' and ixc.is_included_column = 1 if (@count <> 1) begin DROP INDEX IF EXISTS [IX_Field_FieldTypeIdIssueID] ON [dbo].[Field] end
alter table Field alter column [ObjectType] varchar(50) null alter table Field alter column [ObjectID] int null
if not exists (select * from sys.Columns where object_id = object_id('Field') and Name = 'AssetID' and is_sparse = 1) begin alter table Field alter column AssetID bigint SPARSE end
IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE table_name = 'Field' AND column_name = 'IntersectID' ) BEGIN alter table Field add IntersectID int SPARSE END
IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE table_name = 'Field' AND column_name = 'IssueID' ) BEGIN alter table Field add IssueID int SPARSE END
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where Name = 'PK_Field' and type_desc = 'CLUSTERED') begin ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Field] ADD CONSTRAINT [PK_Field] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ON [PRIMARY] end
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where Name = 'IX_Field_FieldTypeID_Include_Ids') begin CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Field_FieldTypeID_Include_Ids] ON [dbo].[Field] ( [FieldTypeID] ASC ) INCLUDE([AssetID],[IntersectID],[IssueID]) end
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where Name = 'IX_Field_FieldTypeIDAssetID_Include') begin CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Field_FieldTypeIDAssetID_Include] ON [dbo].[Field] ([FieldTypeID] ASC, [AssetID] ASC ) INCLUDE([FormattedValue]) end
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where Name = 'IX_Field_FieldTypeIdIntersectID') begin create index [IX_Field_FieldTypeIdIntersectID] on [dbo].[Field](FieldTypeID, IntersectID) end
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where Name = 'IX_Field_FieldTypeIdIssueID') begin create index [IX_Field_FieldTypeIdIssueID] on [dbo].[Field](FieldTypeID, IssueID) end
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where Name = 'IX_Field_AssetID') begin CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Field_AssetID] ON [dbo].[Field] ([AssetID] ASC) end
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where Name = 'IX_Field_IntersectID') begin CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Field_IntersectID] ON [dbo].[Field] ([IntersectID] ASC) end
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where Name = 'IX_Field_IssueID') begin CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Field_IssueID] ON [dbo].[Field] ([IssueID] ASC) end END

CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[Field_AfterDelete] ON [dbo].[Field] AFTER DELETE AS BEGIN -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from -- interfering with SELECT statements. SET NOCOUNT ON;
-- audit field delete INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Object], [ObjectID], [Custom], AssetID) select distinct 'Delete', d.ObjectType, d.ObjectID, (select 'Delete' as Action, i2.ObjectType as ActionObject, i2.ObjectID as ActionObjectID, coalesce(i2.UpdatedBy, 0) as ResourceID, ( select (select d3.FieldTypeID, coalesce(ft.FriendlyName, '<deleted field type>') as [Name], '' as [Value] from deleted d3 left join fieldtype ft on d3.fieldtypeid = ft.id where d3.ObjectID = d.ObjectID for xml path('Field'), TYPE ) for xml path('FieldInfo'), TYPE ) from deleted i2 where i2.ObjectID = d.ObjectID and i2.ObjectType = d.ObjectType group by ObjectType, ObjectID, UpdatedBy for xml path('fields')) , coalesce(d.AssetID,0) as [AssetID] from deleted d; END
